name: Sanctuary
summary: A warm prayer place held within two protective walls. An intimate space for stillness, drawn as a sculptural sign.
why: A folded wall frames an open interior, with a small warm plane at its heart. Seeing the prayer place from above makes this a symbol of entering a quiet space rather than another mosque silhouette. The open front keeps the gesture welcoming.
risk: The abstract room can suggest architecture or interiors; the app name establishes its connection to prayer.
